[Thinking]
**Planning the plot order**

I need to organize the plot, and it seems like it's related to "Family Star" or something similar. I'm considering how to sequence the elements, focusing on presenting it clearly. It's interesting how framing affects the flow of the story, so I want to make sure the arrangement makes sense and engages the audience. I'm curious about how to structure it effectively! Let's figure this out together!
[/Thinking]

<PLOT_SUMMARY> Present: A woman named Indu (Mrunal Thakur) sadly sits in the middle of a ceremony. When she is questioned about her unusual behavior, she tells a story about her past.

Past: Govardhan (Vijay Devarakonda) is a family man. As a selfless character, he works in a business to provide for his family. He also faces trouble with his brother (who is a drunkard). However, he meets Indu when she moves into his ‘space’. That to, Indu and his family quickly become friends. Though annoyed, he continues on in the company, but demands everything Indu gets. Soon, they both fall in love.

However, it is revealed that Indu is actually the daughter of the head. However, when he finds her thesis on his family and him, he slaps her and vows to teach her a lesson. After revealing that she heard him that day, she leaves him. Heartbroken, Indu isolates herself from him.

After learning that his flight tickets weren't payed for, he resorts to Indu, who provides money for his family. He goes to a previous job offeror (Jagapathi Babu), requests to join the company and asks for a big advance. He uses that advance to defy whatever Indu has written in her thesis. After a big incident, he reconciles with his brother after his mother reveals to Indu that his brother hated him because of Govardhan shaming him. After falling in love again, she hears him talking to a lady negatively about Indu saying that she isn't the right person for him.

Present: Govardhan finds out Indu's true intentions of writing the thesis from her father and proceeds to stop her from a wedding, held for one person who got injured due to Govardhan and (according to the person's grandfather- a famous politician) would be the only thing to make him feel better. It is revealed that Indu is at that wedding. Govardhan defeats the politician's goons along with his mother, wins back Indu, and marries her at the end.
